name: Jiangsu Shagang Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Shagang Co., Ltd. engages in the development, smelting, processing, and sale of ferrous metals in China and internationally. It offers steel products, including automotive, engineering machinery, energy, machinery industry, rail transportation, mining, and marine anchor chain steel products; gear products, such as automotive engine, transmission, rear axle, spiral bevel, commercial vehicle, and new energy vehicle gears; cast round billets; and hot-rolled round, flat, and square bars. The company also provides heavy plates, hot-rolled coils, cold-rolled plates, ultra-thin strips, high-speed wire rods, large coils, and ribbed steel bars under the Shagang brand.
